notes.title: 🧊 FEAR BELOW ZERO - Survival Horror Comes to Antarctica 🧊
notes.content: [p]I’m thrilled to announce [b]Fear Below Zero[/b], a first-person survival horror experience that will test your nerves in the most isolated place on Earth. Drawing inspiration from classics like [i]Amnesia: The Bunker[/i] and [i]Alien: Isolation[/i], this isn't just another horror game—it's a frozen nightmare where every breath could be your last.[/p][h2][b]❄️ What Awaits You at Erebus Station[/b][/h2][p]You're a communications technician, caught in a blizzard when you receive a desperate SOS from a remote Antarctic research facility. What started as a routine satellite repair becomes a fight for survival when you discover the researchers have awakened something that should have stayed buried in the ice for 90 million years.[/p][p][b]The Iceman is hunting.[/b][/p][h2][b]🚨 WANT EARLY ACCESS TO THE BETA? 🚨[/b][/h2][p][b]Join our exclusive beta testing program![/b][/p][p]Head to [/p][p][url="https://corsgames.com"]corsgames.com[/url][/p][p] and subscribe to our email list for:[/p][list][*][p]Early beta access[/p][/*][*][p]Behind-the-scenes development updates[/p][/*][*][p]Exclusive concept art and screenshots[/p][/*][*][p]Direct feedback opportunities with the dev team[/p][/*][/list][p][i]The cold is coming. Will you be ready?[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Fear Below Zero now and prepare for a horror experience unlike any other.[/b][/p]
